data.name: Mokshita
data.gender_notes: Mokshita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'muc', meaning 'to free'. Mokshita signifies the release from bondage or suffering, attainment of liberation or salvation. The name Mokshita carries the meaning “Release from bondage or suffering” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mokshita usually hope their child will grow to embody release from bondage or suffering and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of spiritual progress and enlightenment
data.etymology: Mokshita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Release from bondage or suffering.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mokshita total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: In Hinduism, the concept of 'Moksha' or liberation is considered a fundamental goal for all individuals. The term Mokshita holds a significant cultural resonance as it represents the ultimate achievement of this goal. In Hindu society, one who has attained Moksha is revered and respected as they have transcended the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth.
data.spiritual_significance: Mokshita holds immense spiritual significance as it symbolizes the end of the spiritual journey towards enlightenment and the attainment of inner peace. In Hindu philosophical traditions, the individual soul journeys from samsara (the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth) to get united with the Supreme Soul or God. Mokshita represents this union of the individual soul with God and the achievement of the ultimate goal - salvation or eternal peace. This concept encourages individuals to live a virtuous and spiritually enriching life to strive towards the ultimate goal of Moksha.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mokshita: One who is on the path of liberation and enlightenment, seeking to free the soul from the cycle of birth and rebirth. The name signifies the inner journey towards self-realization and ultimate freedom from the material world.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mokshita is a name mentioned in the Mahabharata The name Mokshita carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mokshita is a character in the Mahabharata, a great Indian epic

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mokshita remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Maya Mokshita from Bali, Indonesia embodies the meaning of Mokshita - "Release from bondage or suffering". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
